title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Giving Up a Confirmed Rental Outside the Free Window
content:
Where a renter gives up a confirmed car rental outside the free-cancellation term of the rate class booked, a release charge is withheld on that rental's ledger against the money already taken, and the rental itself is released back to the supplier. The result this basis governs is the money withheld from the renter for giving the rental up; the observable effect is that the renter afterwards holds no booking with the supplier and sees one release charge on the agreement.

The free-cancellation term this scope refers to runs forward from the moment the supplier confirmed the renter's booking, and never backwards from the scheduled collection moment.

The release charge is fixed only after the rental's ledger carries the additional driver charge owed for the drivers named on the agreement.

**Whose act it is.** Releasing the rental is the renter's own act on their own booking. The desk works the charge out from the published terms of the Car Rental Rate Classes and the rental's own records; the release itself is run by the customer themselves.

**How the tool is reached.** The tool `release_rental_booking_4b632ce9` belongs to the renter: the desk unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it. One call by the renter releases the vehicle back to the supplier, moves the rental record to cancelled with the moment the renter gave it up stamped on it, and withholds a single release charge line at the amount supplied.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `drive_rental_id` | The reference number of the renter's own car rental agreement being given up, as it stands on the rental record returned by the car rental lookup | An identifier |
| `release_charge_usd` | The money withheld from the renter for giving the rental up | A positive amount in US dollars with 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the last step only, carrying no currency symbol and no thousands separator |

**Return.** The call comes back with a confirmation sentence naming the released rental agreement, the reference of the release charge line just withheld and the amount in US dollars to two decimal places withheld against it, together with the new state of the rental record. Any other text means the rental was not released.
